# math.NaN, math.Inf, math.Float32frombits and math.Float64frombits with invariant
# arguments are pure and cannot panic, so a loop that stores one is a broadcast fill:
# the call is evaluated once before the loop. The results must match the scalar loop
# bit for bit, which is the only way to compare NaN and negative zero.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

import "math"

func FillNaN(out []float64) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.NaN()
	}
}

func FillNaN32(out []float32) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = float32(math.NaN())
	}
}

func FillInf(out []float64, sign int) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Inf(sign)
	}
}

func FillNegZero(out []float64) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Float64frombits(1 << 63)
	}
}

func FillBits32(out []float32, bits uint32) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Float32frombits(bits)
	}
}

func ScaleByInf(dst, a []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * math.Inf(1)
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"math"
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func FillNaN(out []float64) {
	_vcFloat64s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(math.NaN())
	for _i := 0; _i < len(out); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s0.StorePart(out[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func FillNaN32(out []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(float32(math.NaN()))
	for _i := 0; _i < len(out); {
		_n := _vcFloat32s1.StorePart(out[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func FillInf(out []float64, sign int) {
	_vcFloat64s2 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(math.Inf(sign))
	for _i := 0; _i < len(out); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s2.StorePart(out[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func FillNegZero(out []float64) {
	_vcFloat64s3 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(math.Float64frombits(1 << 63))
	for _i := 0; _i < len(out); {
		_n := _vcFloat64s3.StorePart(out[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func FillBits32(out []float32, bits uint32) {
	_vcFloat32s4 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(math.Float32frombits(bits))
	for _i := 0; _i < len(out); {
		_n := _vcFloat32s4.StorePart(out[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func ScaleByInf(dst, a []float64) {
	_vcFloat64s5 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(math.Inf(1))
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] * math.Inf(1)
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(a[_i:])
				_v1.Mul(_vcFloat64s5).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}

//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

import "math"

func FillNaN(out []float64) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.NaN()
	}
}

func FillNaN32(out []float32) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = float32(math.NaN())
	}
}

func FillInf(out []float64, sign int) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Inf(sign)
	}
}

func FillNegZero(out []float64) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Float64frombits(1 << 63)
	}
}

func FillBits32(out []float32, bits uint32) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Float32frombits(bits)
	}
}

func ScaleByInf(dst, a []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * math.Inf(1)
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 6 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"

	"example.com/test"
)

func bits64(s []float64) (h uint64) {
	for _, v := range s {
		h = h*1099511628211 + math.Float64bits(v)
	}
	return
}

func bits32(s []float32) (h uint64) {
	for _, v := range s {
		h = h*1099511628211 + uint64(math.Float32bits(v))
	}
	return
}

func main() {
	for _, n := range []int{0, 1, 3, 8, 9, 16, 17, 100} {
		a, b := make([]float64, n), make([]float64, n)
		test.FillNaN(a)
		test.FillInf(b, 1)
		fmt.Println(n, "NaN", bits64(a), "+Inf", bits64(b))
		test.FillInf(b, -1)
		test.FillNegZero(a)
		fmt.Println(n, "-Inf", bits64(b), "-0", bits64(a))

		f := make([]float32, n)
		test.FillNaN32(f)
		fmt.Println(n, "NaN32", bits32(f))
		test.FillBits32(f, 0x80000000)
		fmt.Println(n, "-0 32", bits32(f))

		x := make([]float64, n)
		for i := range x {
			x[i] = float64(i%3) - 1
		}
		d := make([]float64, n)
		test.ScaleByInf(d, x)
		fmt.Println(n, "ScaleByInf", bits64(d))
	}
}
